crossRefs.note: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.
The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.
Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.
Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.
I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.
A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.
As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; Or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a…
Won’t the day of Yahweh be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
“In the days of Shamgar the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were unoccupied. The travelers walked…
“Jael shall be blessed above women, the wife of Heber the Kenite; blessed shall she be above women in the tent.
Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.
“There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”

people.name: Hazor
people.line: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua

people.name: Jabin
people.line: Canaanite king who oppressed Israel; defeated by Deborah and Barak.

people.name: Jael
people.line: Wife of Heber; killed Sisera, the Canaanite commander.

people.name: Kenite
people.line: A nomadic tribe friendly to the Israelites

people.name: Sisera
people.line: Canaanite commander defeated by Deborah and Barak.

translations.web: However Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
translations.bsb: Meanwhile, Sisera had fled on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, because there was peace between Jabin king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
translations.kjv: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite: for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
translations.asv: Howbeit Sisera fled away on his feet to the tent of Jael the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin the king of Hazor and the house of Heber the Kenite.
